management_remarks: Closing FY25, TCS crossed Rs 2,49,500 Crore in annual revenue with Q4 TCV surging to an all-time high of USD 12.2 billion and full-year EBIT margin at 24.5%. North America BFSI and UK markets posted accelerated sequential momentum as large banks resumed core platform modernization and data estate transformation. With Rs 47,600 Crore in cash and investments and virtually zero debt, the Board declared a substantial final dividend rewarding long-term shareholders.
analyst_qa: Responding to questions on US tariff and macro uncertainty, global enterprise clients are cautious on new discretionary capex, making immediate Q1 ramp-ups challenging and subject to macro clarity. While AI deal wins are strong, legacy code maintenance cannibalization creates uncertain net billing dynamics during transition phases. Sub-contractor and travel costs are calibrated tightly to defend margins against volatile currency movements.
